definitions.explanation: Time and space considered together, as in physics (relativity) and, more often in everyday use, in science fiction, fantasy and poetic phrases about crossing eras or worlds.

examples.japanese: {時空|じくう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}える→超える：01942_koeru⟧。
⟦{主人公|しゅじんこう}→主人公：11404_shujinkou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{時空|じくう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{歪|ゆが}み→歪み：09409_yugami⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{落|お}ちて→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧しまった。
examples.english: The hero fell into a distortion in space-time.

examples.japanese: {相対性理論|そうたいせいりろん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧よれば、⟦{重|おも}い→重い：00804_omoi⟧⟦{物体|ぶったい}→物体：13506_buttai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{時空|じくう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{曲|ま}がっている→曲がる：00649_magaru⟧。
examples.english: According to the theory of relativity, space-time is curved around massive objects.

notes:
From ⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧ (time) + ⟦{空|くう}→空〜：03949_kuu⟧ (space).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {時空|じくう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}える→超える：01942_koeru⟧: to transcend time and space
- {時空|じくう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{歪|ゆが}み→歪み：09409_yugami⟧: a distortion of space-time
- {時空|じくう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}えた→超える：01942_koeru⟧⟦{愛|あい}→愛：02370_ai⟧: a love that transcends time and space
